ideas.pitch: An IoT-based smart campus microgrid controller featuring automated relay protection and load shedding to optimize energy distribution.
ideas.problem_statement: Track 1: Smart Campus & Energy Management (IoT, Microgrids, Relay Protection)
ideas.title: CampusMicrogridOptimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses Track 1 directly with physical relay modules and current sensors, demonstrating a live closed-loop hardware response rather than just a dashboard.

ideas.pitch: An embedded biomedical wearable providing real-time post-operative patient monitoring with targeted haptic feedback alerts.
ideas.problem_statement: Track 2: MedTech & Assistive Wearables (Embedded Sensors, Haptic Feedback)
ideas.title: PostOpHapticVest
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning pattern of biomedical IoT edge systems and embeds physical haptic actuators that create an engaging live hardware demo for judges.

ideas.pitch: An obstacle-avoiding autonomous rover utilizing customized motor drivers and microcontrollers for campus utility transport.
ideas.problem_statement: Track 3: Robotics & Autonomous Systems (Rovers, Motor Drivers, Microcontrollers)
ideas.title: AutonomousCampusDeliveryRover
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits Track 3 with a fully functional physical robot prototype, matching the profile of past international hardware hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: An edge-AI hardware node using a camera module and microcontroller to instantly detect safety gear violations on the factory floor.
ideas.problem_statement: Track 4: Open Innovation (AgriTech, Industrial Automation, Environmental Monitoring)
ideas.title: IndustrialSafetyVisionNode
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines edge computer vision with industrial automation constraints, directly appealing to open innovation judges looking for practical deployment value.

ideas.pitch: An off-grid acoustic walkie-talkie mesh network routing ultra-fast emergency data packets without cellular infrastructure.
ideas.problem_statement: Track 4: Open Innovation (AgriTech, Industrial Automation, Environmental Monitoring)
ideas.title: AcousticMeshFieldComm
ideas.why_it_could_win: Wins on unique physical hardware capabilities by demonstrating robust off-grid RF and acoustic communication live on campus.
